item.title: ConformTXT 0.6.15
item.description: - ChatGPT, Codex and Claude: ConformTXT stays out. What you paste there goes in exactly as copied (they show it in their own font anyway). - A table copied from Excel, Google Sheets or Numbers pastes as normal, with its colors, borders and column widths. - Other tables keep their merged cells. - When the font can't be read and the copy has a table or picture, it's a normal paste instead of plain text, so nothing is lost. - Pages: plain text in the document's own font is now the expected result there, not flagged as a problem.
